evals.prompt: @create-subagent make a project-local read-only accessibility reviewer. Require the existing verify-ui skill, inherit my model, and do not launch it yet.
evals.expected_output: Checks the skill and ID, writes .opencode/agents/<id>.md with V2 subagent mode and edit/shell/subagent deny rules, and distinguishes file validation from discovery or a live test.

evals.prompt: @delegate update this parser and add its regression cases. Two workers would need to edit the same source file; worktree creation is unavailable. Keep the evidence from any failed attempt.
evals.expected_output: Serializes overlapping writers, writes unique parent-owned per-attempt briefs and reports, relays accepted predecessor evidence, and checks the actual diff and test receipts before accepting PASS.

evals.prompt: @swarm audit three packages read-only. Do not write anything in the repository. One worker cannot access its package, and another reports PASS without the exact requested SHA.
evals.expected_output: Records coordination in host scratch, reports inaccessible coverage as BLOCKED, rejects the missing-SHA report, performs at most one replacement after the predecessor stops, and does not call the whole run a pass with a gap.

evals.prompt: @swarm race two isolated implementations with first pass. The first worker says PASS but has no test output; the second has verified evidence. A previous writer is still running.
evals.expected_output: Selects only a parent-validated result, does not trust the first self-report, does not overlap a replacement with a running writer, and waits for terminal accounting before claiming completion.
